_note: The research ecology's cycle state (ecology v3, 2026-08-30; continuing question since 2026-10-03; convening since 2026-10-07). Read by the three practices at every session open; never advanced by a practice. Advanced by the architect or a site session, and — while a continuing question is set — by the cycle clock under fixed rules: a cycle whose three presentations stand opens a convening (phase "convening" with a convening block; cycle and question stay those of the presented cycle), in which each practice proposes the next question and ranks the proposals through the Middle's relay; the relay's tally opens the next cycle (source "convening") the day after it was tallied unless the architect objects (convening.objected); without a result seven days after the convening opened, the next cycle opens on the continuing question; a seed released to all three interrupts at once, in either phase, and only a seed's own cycle is never cut short (src/lib/ecology/cycle-turn.ts, run by .github/workflows/cycle-sentinel.yml). Decision records: docs/design/2026-08-30-research-ecology-v3.md, docs/design/2026-10-03-the-continuing-question.md, docs/design/2026-10-07-the-convening.md. The defaults apply only when no continuing question is set.
question: When famine is declared only where data can be gathered, what does the record write for the places no one could reach, and how much of that blank did the cuts to aid and monitoring make?

defaults.field: How can end-to-end automation of AI research be realised? Build it, and measure where it breaks.
defaults.atelier: How can AI and automation meaningfully support artistic research?
defaults.studio: Take the Atlas of Data Art as a source of inspiration and build works, investigations or instruments with a unique selling point of their own: never copy an idea or a concept, but make something new, or take an existing work further, or carry it into a new context. The siblings' research material remains material.

transition: The convening after cycle 010 (opened 2026-10-26) closed on 2026-10-29: the three practices proposed and ranked, and the Atelier's proposal won the tally of 2026-10-28 (the Atelier 5 · the Studio 4 · the Field 0, borda). No objection came within a day. Cycle 011 opens on it. Turned by the cycle clock under the rules of 2026-10-03 and 2026-10-07.
